svg.title: THREEFOLD browser memory comparison
svg.desc: Two thirty-minute heap traces with alternating crowd load cycles, a 300 MiB target line, and retained resource-count growth reported for each run.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(6%,11%,13%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Thirty minutes each. One sample per second. Shading marks the synthetic crowd being loaded.
Peak estimate 517.3 MiB / final retained-count growth 0.00% / hidden samples 0

g.text: Chromium performance.memory is an approximate heap estimate, not isolated process or GPU memory.
The workload creates/disposes synthetic crowd instances; it does not perform real zone transfers or force garbage collection.
